page.overview:
Who is Tifa?

Tifa is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. She is a Grymoirian incarnation of Tifa Lockhart originating from Final Fantasy VII. Tifa is one of the five character representatives of the Final Fantasy VII series, the other four being Cloud, Sephiroth, Shelke, and Zack (the latter appearing only in the Maxima version).

The player can take on Intervention Quests that center around Tifa.

Tifa also appears in the following Intervention Quest.

As a Champion, Tifa can be summoned to assist Lann and Reynn in battle. Upon acquiring Tifa's Champion Medal, the player can summon her to attack one enemy with the ability Final Heaven. The party is also bestowed with .
